author: Cosmic_Fyre
body:
Well i thought id make this cos i`m bored... xD

I doubt any of u know me.. i`m not exactly a forum person, so yea, but i`m bored, so WHY NOT xD
Some of you may have seen me in-game, as that crazy guy who ignores loot chests and gear and go straight for bridging and sniping. because of my play strategy i don`t really care about my k/d.. as such its about .5 right now xD however i have been avicus for a VERY long time, in fact it was my very first mini-game server. I remember when the lobby was a small floating platform and hunger games was just as popular as Nebula.. Even tho there was only 1 SG lobby xD. everyone would spam the buttons in the cramped waiting room :P [im sounding old here arent i? xD] But yea, i`ve been here a long time. I once submitted my first map.. but i was very nooby about it.. xD the map was pretty bad anyways. I come on every week or so for a good long session of nebula, although i sometimes take loooong breaks. [ive gotten into skyblock 2.0 recently.] But yea, thatswhats interesting about my life on the server, but what about irl? Well, here are the things to know about me:

My name is Riley
I have 1 sister
I live with my mum
I have a cat name loopy [she suits the name, trust me]
I am 16 and 1/2 years old
I live in New Zealand
City: Dunedin :P
I have 2 minecraft accounts, my main, and one i use for afking on skyblock
Want to know more? ask below :D

-Cosmic
